title: Watching a video
technical: The app fetches the video in small segments over HTTPS (HTTP inside TLS inside TCP), and the server streams them back.

takes.simple: The whole video gets here in about {time}: {faster} times faster than you can watch it.
takes.technical: {size} of HD video at {rate}, the slowest link’s speed ({link}): all {plays} in about {time}, {faster}× faster than it plays. The player fetches only a little ahead, so the line mostly rests.

phone.simple: Your phone wants a cat video, so it writes a little request and sends it off.
phone.technical: The app opens a TLS connection and sends an HTTP GET for the next video segment. The OS splits the data into TCP segments inside IP packets.

1995.title: Opening a web page with a picture
1995.simple: You open a web page with a picture on it.
1995.technical: The browser fetches the page, then its picture, each with an HTTP/1.0 GET on a TCP connection of its own: plain HTTP, no TLS. SSL had just come out in Netscape, for shops. Video was stamp-sized clips (160 × 120, a few frames a second) that you downloaded before watching.

peek.page: Caught: a piece of the page

takes.simple: The page and its picture take about {time} to get here. Today’s video would take {now}!
takes.technical: {size} at {rate}, the modem’s top speed: about {time} for the bits alone, more with the handshakes, headers and resends. Today’s {nowSize} of HD video would take {now}.

2010.title: Watching a small video
2010.simple: You ask for a small video.
2010.technical: The player fetches the video as one file over plain HTTP (no TLS): a small 360p MP4 that starts playing while the rest is still on its way (progressive download). Video sites moved to HTTPS a few years later. The cache it came from was usually in a bigger city further away than today’s.

takes.simple: The whole small video gets here in about {time}: {faster} times faster than you can watch it. Today’s sharper video would take {now}.
takes.technical: {size} of 360p video at {rate}, the slowest link’s speed ({link}): all {plays} in about {time}, {faster}× faster than it plays. Today’s {nowSize} of HD video would take {now}.

phone.technical: The app sends one HTTP GET for the whole video file, in plain HTTP (no TLS). The OS puts the request in a TCP segment inside an IP packet.
